column1: 30501§remediable§rɪˈmiːdiəbl§adj. 可补救的；可纠正的；可改善的§Although this approach can yield many insights about the biological past, it remains a relatively underutilized resource in part because hDNA is often to some extent degraded, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.§尽管这一方法能揭示关于生物历史的诸多信息，它仍是一种相对未被充分利用的资源，部分原因在于历史 DNA 往往有一定程度的降解，而在现有的方法论范式与 DNA 提取分析技术下，这一状况不易**补救**。§Although this approach offers unique benefits, such as the ability to contrast historical genomic data with present-day data, it remains relatively underutilized because archival specimens are sometimes stored in ways that compromise DNA quality, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.§尽管这种方法有独特优势（如把历史基因组数据与当下数据作对比），它仍未被充分利用：档案标本的保存方式有时会损害 DNA 质量，在现行方法论范式与现存 DNA 提取、分析技术下都不易**补救**。§remedy v. 补救 → remediable；反义 irremediable 无可挽回的§not easily remediable 不易补救§§改译文：前半译的是另一版本的句子（「独特优势、已灭绝种群」），英文是「能揭示生物历史」，并漏译 in part

30502§volitional§vəˈlɪʃənl§adj. 有意的；自主意志的；有意为之的§Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Japan and Turkey, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an instruction to laugh.§来自 21 个社会（包括日本与土耳其）的研究参与者，听了一批随机排序的录音：18 段取自女性两两之间自然对话中的自发笑声，以及由 18 名不同女性按「笑一下」的指令分别发出的 18 段**有意**笑声。§Psychologists Gregory Bryant, Dorsa Amir, and colleagues investigated cross-cultural perceptions of spontaneous (real) laughter and volitional (fake or forced) laughter.§心理学家 Gregory Bryant、Dorsa Amir 及同事研究了不同文化对自发（真实）笑声与**自主**（伪装或勉强）笑声的感知。§§volitional laughter 有意发出的笑§与 spontaneous（自发的、不由自主的）构成反义对照，实验设计常用这一对概念§改译文：英文举例是日本与土耳其，原译成奥地利与萨摩亚；pairs of women 是女性两两对话

30503§reduplication§rɪˌdjuːplɪˈkeɪʃn§n. （语言学）重叠；重叠构词（词根成分在相关词中重复）§This phenomenon, in which an element of a root word is repeated, sometimes with modification, within another word that is related to the root word, is called reduplication.§某一词根的成分在与之相关的另一个词内部重复（有时带变化），这一现象称为**重叠构词**。§There are many examples of this type of reduplication in Hoocak.§霍乔克语中有许多这类**重叠构词**的例子。§re- 再 + duplicate 复制 → reduplicate → reduplication；语言学专门术语§§如 teeny-weeny：词根成分在同一词族另一词内部重复，可带音变§

30504§demarcate§ˈdiːmɑːkeɪt§v. 划定界限；划分；区分§Noting that some stories feature detailed descriptions of geographic locations in the Cherokee homeland, Mooney demarcated those as a genre he referred to as “wonder stories.” While Long and Mooney’s collaboration proved valuable as an act of cultural preservation, it is important to bear in mind that Cherokee people are not known to have applied genre divisions to their stories before Mooney’s work.§Mooney 注意到有些故事对切罗基故土的地理位置有细致描写，便把这类故事**划为**一个他称为「奇谭」的体裁。尽管 Long 与 Mooney 的合作作为一项文化保存工作颇有价值，但须记住：在 Mooney 的工作之前，并无已知记载表明切罗基人曾给自己的故事划分体裁。§§§de- 加强 + mark 标记 → demarcate；名词 demarcation 分界§demarcate A as B 把 A 划归为 B；demarcation n. 分界；划界§§改译文：漏译后一句（Long 与 Mooney 的合作、切罗基人原本不分体裁）

30505§entangle§ɪnˈtæŋɡl§v. 使缠结；缠住；使卷入（纠纷、关系）§Her sculpture Ocupante is made of entangled blue and white LED tubes.§她的雕塑《Ocupante》由蓝白两色 LED 灯管**缠绕**而成。§§§§entangled tubes 缠绕的管子；be entangled in 卷入（纠纷、关系）；entanglement n. 纠缠；牵连§§

30506§hedonic§hiːˈdɒnɪk§adj. 享乐的；与快感有关的；享乐型的§They hypothesized that hedonic motivation (the enjoyment that a consumer perceives to be associated with using a service) would be positively correlated with users’ intentions to adopt premium versions.§他们假设，**享乐**动机（消费者认为使用某项服务所带来的愉悦）会与用户采用付费版本的意愿正相关。§However, Lee and Hosanagar also determined that whereas an RS had a stronger positive effect on item views for utilitarian products (e.g., toothbrushes) than for hedonic products (e.g., chocolates), the RS had a stronger positive effect on likelihood of purchase for hedonic products than for utilitarian ones.§然而 Lee 与 Hosanagar 还发现：推荐系统（RS）对实用型产品（如牙刷）浏览量的提升强于**享乐型**产品（如巧克力），但对享乐型产品购买可能性的提升反而更强。§§hedonic motivation 享乐动机；hedonic products 享乐型产品§消费行为学里与 utilitarian（实用性的）相对：一个买「爽」，一个买「用」§改译文2：RS 指推荐系统（Lee 与 Hosanagar 研究推荐系统），原译「评分」不对

30507§desiccation§ˌdesɪˈkeɪʃn§n. 干燥；脱水；干涸§To characterize the nature of the depositional environment, Frances Rivera-Hernández et al. analyzed the grain size of Murray Formation sediment, finding that although there are intervals of coarse grains, most of the sediment consists of fine grains that show signs of cracking due to episodic desiccation.§为了刻画沉积环境的性质，Frances Rivera-Hernández 等人分析了默里组沉积物的粒度，发现虽然有若干粗颗粒层段，但大部分沉积物由细颗粒组成，这些颗粒显示出因周期性**干燥**而开裂的迹象。§§§de- 去除 + sicc（拉丁 siccus 干）→ desiccate → desiccation；地质学常用§episodic desiccation 周期性干涸§§改译文：漏译前半句（研究目的、Rivera-Hernández 等人分析粒度、粗颗粒层段）

30508§gratify§ˈɡrætɪfaɪ§v. 使满足；使高兴；使欣慰§Still, he knows that each component of a building, however small, is nevertheless essential, and he finds it gratifying that after all his years of schooling, all his crits [reviews] and unbuilt projects, his efforts are to have some practical end.§不过他知道，建筑的每一个构件无论多小都不可或缺；让他**欣慰**的是，求学多年、经历过那么多评图与未能建成的方案之后，自己的努力总算有了实际用处。§§§§find it gratifying that… 对…感到欣慰；gratifying adj. 令人欣慰的；gratification n. 满足§比 satisfy 更偏情感上的满足；gratifying 常作形容词「令人欣慰的」§

30509§obtrusive§əbˈtruːsɪv§adj. 显眼的；扎眼的；冒失的§The changes of the seasons are less obtrusive on spots of this kind than amid woodland scenery.§在这类地方，季节的更替不如在林地里那样**惹眼**。§§§ob- 朝向 + trude 推 → obtrude 强加 → obtrusive；反义 unobtrusive 不露痕迹的§less obtrusive 不那么扎眼§§

30510§epistolary§ɪˈpɪstələri§adj. 书信的；书信体的；以书信形式写成的§The Incarnations (2015) is an epistolary novel by English author Susan Barker.§《The Incarnations》（2015）是英国作家 Susan Barker 的一部**书信体**小说。§Epistolary novels are novels written primarily as a series of fictional documents.§**书信体**小说是主要以一系列虚构文件的形式写成的小说。§epistle 书信 → epistolary；SAT 文学体裁题高频标签§epistolary novel 书信体小说§§改译文2：原译缺谓语「是」，句子不通；documents 是「文件」，不只是书信

30511§constrict§kənˈstrɪkt§v. 使收缩；使变窄；限制；约束§Studies have found that when looking at other people’s eyes, humans tend to perceive dilated pupils positively and constricted pupils negatively.§研究发现，人在注视他人眼睛时，倾向于对放大的瞳孔作正面评价，对**缩小**的瞳孔作负面评价。§§§§constricted pupils 缩小的瞳孔；constrict freedom 限制自由；constriction n. 收缩；限制§§

30512§ersatz§ˈeəzæts§adj. 仿制的；代用的；冒牌的§Ersatz presentism posits that the statement is made true by an abstract (“ersatz”) time that exists outside temporal time and represents how things were in the past.§「**仿制**现在论」主张：该陈述之所以为真，是因为存在一个处于时间之外、代表过去事物状态的抽象「仿制」时间。§Lucretianism posits that the statement is made true by the world’s acceptance of the past-tensed property of “having contained dinosaurs.” 2006: Presentist philosopher Craig Bourne proposed “ersatz presentism.”§卢克莱修主义主张：该陈述之为真，在于世界接受了「曾经包含恐龙」这一过去时态属性。2006 年，现在论哲学家 Craig Bourne 提出「**代用品**现在论」。§§ersatz coffee 代用咖啡；ersatz presentism （哲学）仿制现在论§哲学「仿制现在论」以抽象的替代物（ersatz time）充当过去§改例句2：两处右引号后多了一个句点；改译文2：删去两句之间多余的破折号

30513§traceability§ˌtreɪsəˈbɪləti§n. 可追溯性；可追查性§The team gave each of these studies a rating for level of traceability (with a higher rating for clearer description of procedures) and for category consistency (with a higher rating for using materials categories more closely aligned with the categories in the team's database).§团队为每项研究评定了**可追溯性**等级（程序描述越清晰得分越高）与类别一致性等级（所用材料类别越接近团队数据库的分类，得分越高）。§§§trace 追踪 → traceable → traceability；科研可复现性讨论的核心指标§level of traceability 可追溯性等级§§

30514§imperceptible§ˌɪmpəˈseptəbl§adj. 难以察觉的；感觉不到的；细微的§Because they penetrate the visible surface of a painting, ultraviolet and other nonvisible spectra of light enable the detection of otherwise imperceptible features of the work.§由于紫外线及其他不可见光谱能穿透画面的表层，它们使画作中那些原本**难以察觉**的特征得以被发现。§§§im- 否定 + perceptible 可感知的；反义 perceptible 明显的§imperceptible features 肉眼难见的细节§§

30515§chastise§tʃæˈstaɪz§v. 严厉批评；斥责；惩罚§Wade cites features of the texts indicative of live performance, such as chastising the audience, extensive use of simple structures (allowing for easy memorization), and requests for tips (payment) from listeners.§Wade 举出文本中表明现场表演的特征，例如**数落**观众、大量使用易于记诵的简单结构，以及向听众索要赏钱。§§§§chastise the audience 数落观众§与 castigate 近义，语气正式；真题中指现场表演者调侃、责备观众§

30516§cuneiform§ˈkjuːnɪfɔːm§adj. 楔形的；楔形文字的 n. 楔形文字§The cuneiform script is the earliest known set of symbols used for writing.§**楔形文字**是目前已知最早的一套用于书写的符号系统。§Sumerian was one of the first languages to be written using the cuneiform script.§苏美尔语是最早用**楔形文字**书写的语言之一。§cuneus 楔 + form 形状 → 笔画呈楔状§cuneiform script 楔形文字§楔形文字是美索不达米亚最早的文字系统§

30517§absenteeism§ˌæbsənˈtiːɪzəm§n. 旷工；（经常性）缺勤；缺勤率§Michelle Pereira et al. hypothesized that introducing health improvements into workplaces would increase productivity by reducing absenteeism (sick employees not working) and presenteeism (sick workers working less productively due to illness).§Michelle Pereira 等人假设，在工作场所推行健康改善措施可以提高生产率，途径是减少**缺勤**（生病员工不来上班）与「带病出勤」（生病员工上班但效率降低）。§§§§reduce absenteeism 降低缺勤率§与 presenteeism（带病出勤、人在心不在）成对出现，是职场健康研究的两个指标§

30518§dwindle§ˈdwɪndl§v. 逐渐减少；缩小；萎缩§In response to a rapidly dwindling population of blueback salmon, the Quinault Indian Nation (a tribe in Washington State) partnered with the conservation organization Wild Salmon Center to restore naturally occurring logjams in the Quinault River.§面对蓝背鲑数量的急剧**下降**，奎诺尔特印第安部落（华盛顿州的一个部落）与保护组织「野鲑中心」合作，在奎诺尔特河恢复天然形成的木桩阻塞。§§§§dwindling population 不断萎缩的种群§强调持续、不可逆的减少；比 decrease 更有「日渐枯竭」的意味§

30519§reticent§ˈretɪsnt§adj. 沉默寡言的；有所保留的；不愿透露的§The narrator has asked the woman he rents a room from about Ethan Frome, a town resident he encountered recently. Her mind was a store-house of innocuous anecdote and any question about her acquaintances brought forth a volume of detail; but on the subject of Ethan Frome I found her unexpectedly reticent.§叙述者向他租住房间的房东太太打听镇上居民 Ethan Frome（他最近遇到过此人）。她的脑子是无伤大雅的趣闻的宝库，问起她的任何熟人都能引出一大堆细节；但一谈到 Ethan Frome，我发现她出乎意料地**不愿多言**。§§§§reticent about sth 对某事避而不谈；reticence n. 沉默寡言；有所保留§不是「害羞」，而是「刻意不说」§改例句：recently 后漏空格；改译文：漏译前面的背景句和 Her mind… 一句，且把人名 Ethan Frome 误加书名号

30520§coalesce§ˌkəʊəˈles§v. 合并；联合；凝聚成形§Magical realism, a style that weaves fantasy into realistic narratives, coalesced in Latin America in the 1960s.§魔幻现实主义——一种把幻想编织进现实叙事的风格——于 1960 年代在拉丁美洲**成形**。§One popular theory of the origin of the Moon, the "big whack," posits that a protoplanet called Theia collided with Earth, flinging debris into orbit that eventually coalesced into the Moon.§一种流行的月球起源理论——「大碰撞说」——认为：一颗名为忒伊亚的原行星撞上地球，抛出的碎片进入轨道，最终**聚合**成月球。§co- 共同 + alescere 生长；名词 coalescence 合并§coalesce into 汇合成；coalescence n. 合并§§

30521§overreach§ˌəʊvəˈriːtʃ§v. 做事过头；不自量力；越界 n. 越界；过度扩张§Such laws, enacted against a backdrop of anxiety about social dynamism, were intended to limit aspirational overreaching for status but were infrequently enforced.§这类法律在人们对社会阶层流动感到焦虑的背景下颁布，本意是限制为攫取地位而进行的攀比**越界**，却很少真正执行。§§§§overreach oneself 弄巧成拙；overreaching for status 为攀比地位而越界§社会史语境中 overreaching for status 指僭越等级、攀比地位§

30522§counterintuitive§ˌkaʊntərɪnˈtjuːɪtɪv§adj. 违反直觉的；与常理相悖的§Perhaps counterintuitively, a focus on group distinctions can help ensure that responsibility for issues with global effects (e.g., freshwater shortages and biodiversity loss) is shared globally.§或许**有悖直觉**的是，聚焦群体差异反而有助于确保：对具有全球性影响的问题（如淡水短缺、生物多样性丧失），责任由全球共同分担。§§§counter- 反 + intuitive 直觉的；SAT 科学类文章的高频评价词§seem counterintuitive 看似不合常理；counterintuitively adv. 有违直觉地§§改例句：删去混入的 Text 1 末句和「Text 2」标签；改译文：相应删去前半

30523§meander§miˈændə§n. （河流的）弯道；河曲 v. 蜿蜒而行；（谈话、思路）漫无边际地展开§U-shaped curve in a river channel is called a meander.§河道中呈 U 形的弯曲称为**河曲**。§A river with high sinuosity has many meanders, and a river with low sinuosity has few.§弯曲度高的河流有许多**河曲**，弯曲度低的河流则很少。§§§§改例句2：句末多余的「 .」

30524§reductive§rɪˈdʌktɪv§adj. 过于简化的；简单化的§Alemu Mekonnen and Gunnar Kohlin's study of fuel use in Ethiopia shows how reductive this model is, however: although income of course constrained fuel choice, several circumstances, including the local availability of different fuel sources, influenced decisions.§然而，Alemu Mekonnen 与 Gunnar Kohlin 对埃塞俄比亚燃料使用的研究显示，这一模型何等**简化**：收入固然制约了燃料选择，但包括当地各类燃料可获得性在内的多种情况都影响了决策。§Rasmus Heltberg’s study of fuel use in Ghana shows this model to be reductive, however: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors, including the stability of the local electrical grid.§然而 Rasmus Heltberg 对加纳燃料使用的研究表明该模型**过于简化**：家庭燃料使用是异质而灵活的，受当地电网稳定性等多种因素影响。§reduce 缩减 → reductive；reductionism 还原论，学术批评常用贬义§§§

30525§ascribe§əˈskraɪb§v. 把…归因于；认为…属于§The linguistic niche hypothesis (LNH) posits that the exotericity of languages (how prevalent non-native speakers are) and grammatical complexity are inversely related, which the LNH ascribes to attrition of complex grammatical rules as more non-native speakers adopt the language but fail to acquire those rules.§语言生态位假说认为，语言的「外族性」（非母语使用者的普遍程度）与语法复杂度呈反比；该假说把这**归因于**：随着越来越多非母语者习得该语言却未能掌握这些规则，复杂的语法规则逐渐磨蚀。§§§§ascribe A to B 把 A 归因于 B§与 attribute 近义；ascribe 更常用于「把…说成是…造成的」这一解释性语境§

30526§guile§ɡaɪl§n. 诡计；狡诈；心机§Aunt Polly asked [Tom] questions that were full of guile, and very deep—for she wanted to trap him into damaging revealments.§波莉姨妈问汤姆的问题满是**圈套**，而且用意极深——她想诱他露出破绽。§§§§full of guile 满是心机§文学语域，与 cunning 近义；反义形容词 guileless「不设防的、天真坦率的」§

30527§surrealist§səˈrɪəlɪst§adj. 超现实主义的 n. 超现实主义者§Felipe Posada (pseudonym The Invisible Realm) is a New York City-based artist who specializes in the form of art known as surrealist collage.§Felipe Posada（化名 The Invisible Realm）是一位常驻纽约的艺术家，专攻**超现实主义**拼贴。§§§sur- 超 + real 现实 → surreal → surrealism → surrealist§surrealist collage 超现实主义拼贴§§

30528§laity§ˈleɪəti§n. （与神职人员相对的）平信徒；俗人；外行§Ely is a clergyman in the town of Milby. By the laity of Milby and its neighbourhood [Mr. Ely] was regarded as a man of quite remarkable powers and learning, who must make a considerable sensation in London pulpits and drawing-rooms on his occasional visit to the metropolis; and by his brother clergy he was regarded as a discreet and agreeable fellow.§Ely 是米尔比镇的一位牧师。在米尔比及其周边的**平信徒**看来，Ely 先生是一位能力与学识都相当出众的人，偶尔造访伦敦时，必将在伦敦的讲道坛与沙龙里引起不小的轰动；而在同僚教士眼中，他是个谨慎而随和的人。§§§§the laity 平信徒（总称）§与 clergy（神职人员）成对；形容词 lay 世俗的、非专业的§改例句：句子在「[Mr.」处被截断，按 U12 pulpit 条的同一真题句补全后半；改译文：相应补译后半句

30529§conciliatory§kənˈsɪliətəri§adj. 安抚的；和解的；调和的§Conciliatory responses were most effective at mitigating the impact of concrete reviews, whereas more defensive responses were more useful when reviews were relatively abstract.§**安抚性**回应在减轻具体评论所带来的冲击方面最为有效，而当评论相对抽象时，更具防御性的回应则更有用。§§§conciliate 安抚 → conciliatory；与 confrontational 相对§conciliatory response 安抚性回应§§改译文：漏译 whereas 后半句（评论抽象时防御性回应更有用）

30530§fulcrum§ˈfʊlkrəm§n. （杠杆的）支点；支轴；（比喻）关键支撑点§A lever is a simple machine consisting of a rigid beam and a fulcrum.§杠杆是一种简单机械，由一根刚性横梁和一个**支点**构成。§In first-class levers, the fulcrum is located between the effort and the load.§在第一类杠杆中，**支点**位于作用力与负荷之间。§§§§改例句2：句末多一个句点

30531§straddle§ˈstrædl§v. 跨坐；叉腿站立；横跨；介于（两者）之间§The late-period pieces of James Tate arguably fit this description, since they straddle the line between prose and poetry.§James Tate 晚期的作品大概符合这一描述，因为它们**横跨**在散文与诗歌的分界线上。§Her art, too, straddles multiple boundaries.§她的艺术同样**跨越**多重边界。§§straddle the line between A and B 介于 A 与 B 之间§§

30532§oddity§ˈɒdəti§n. 怪异的事物；古怪的人；奇特§Virginia Woolf’s 1928 novel Orlando is an oddity within her body of work.§弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫 1928 年的小说《Orlando》是她全部作品中一个**异类**。§§§odd 奇怪的 → oddity；与 anomaly 近义§an oddity within one’s body of work 某人全部作品中的异类§§

30533§associative§əˈsəʊʃətɪv§adj. 联想的；联合的；关联的§In a study of the mechanisms underlying associative memory—or the ability to learn and remember connections between inherently unrelated things—neuroscientists Kei Igarashi, Jasmine Chavez, and others presented mice with memory tests.§在一项关于**联想**记忆机制（即学习并记住本无关联事物之间联系的能力）的研究中，神经科学家 Kei Igarashi、Jasmine Chavez 等人对小鼠进行了记忆测试。§The team discovered that fan cells, a type of cell found in the medial temporal lobe of the brain, are necessary for the acquisition of new associative memories.§研究团队发现：扇形细胞——大脑内侧颞叶中的一类细胞——是获得新**联想**记忆的必要条件。§associate 关联 → associative；与 linear（线性的）对照§associative memory 联想记忆；associative logic 联想逻辑§形容思路时指依凭自由联想而非线性逻辑展开§

30534§forthright§ˈfɔːθraɪt§adj. 直率的；坦率的；直截了当的§Autofiction usually borrows formal elements from autobiographical writing too, including its first person point of view and its use of a narrative voice so forthright that it borders on confessional.§自传体小说通常也借用自传写作的形式要素，包括第一人称视角，以及一种**直率**到近乎自白的叙事声音。§§§§so forthright that it borders on confessional 直率到近乎自白§§

30535§anthropogenic§ˌænθrəpəˈdʒenɪk§adj. 人为的；人类活动造成的§In a meta-analysis of more than 100 studies of anthropogenic noise and various species and classes of animals, Kunc and Schmidt found that, on average, mammals showed larger effects from the noise than birds did.§Kunc 与 Schmidt 对 100 多项关于**人为**噪声与各类动物的研究做了元分析，发现平均而言哺乳动物受到的影响大于鸟类。§The researchers ultimately recommended that reducing anthropogenic emissions remain the primary focus of urban air-quality improvement efforts.§研究者最终建议：改善城市空气质量仍应以削减**人为**排放为首要目标。§anthropo- 人类 + -genic 产生；气候、生态语境的核心术语§anthropogenic noise 人为噪声；anthropogenic emissions 人为排放§§

30537§outlay§ˈaʊtleɪ§n. 支出；开销；（一次性）投入资金§Private foundations are prohibited from holding excess interests in a business enterprise, “self-dealing” (conducting activities that benefit foundation insiders), making taxable expenditures such as outlays for lobbying, and failing to cross a required threshold in making charitable distributions from income.§私人基金会不得在企业中持有超额权益、不得进行「自我交易」（从事使基金会内部人获益的活动）、不得进行应税支出（如游说**开支**），也不得在从收入中划拨慈善捐赠时未达到规定比例。§§§§outlays for lobbying 游说开支；outlay on sth 在某方面的开支§比 expense 更强调「一次性投入的款项」§原书错：把 outlay on sth 标作「动词短语」，实为名词 outlay 加 on（在…上的支出）

30538§amiable§ˈeɪmiəbl§adj. 和蔼可亲的；友善的；亲切的§It is very earnestly [the Mirvans’] wish to enlarge and enliven their party by the addition of your amiable ward, who would share, equally with her own daughter, the care and attention of Mrs. Mirvan.§Mirvan 一家非常恳切地希望，让您那位**和蔼可亲**的被监护人加入他们一行，使队伍更壮大、更热闹；她将与 Mirvan 夫人的亲生女儿一样，平等地得到 Mirvan 夫人的照顾与关心。§§§§your amiable ward 您那位可亲的被监护人§与 amicable（关系和睦的）区分：amiable 形容人，amicable 形容关系或协议§改例句：删去句首混入的上句残片「Mirvan’s family.」，句末 Mrs. 后补被截掉的 Mirvan；改译文：漏译 enlarge 和 who would share… 一句

30544§exacerbate§ɪɡˈzæsəbeɪt§v. 使加剧；使恶化§In response to concerns that some recent financial crises were exacerbated by consumers misunderstanding risks associated with credit cards, loans, and other financial products, policymakers in many countries have instituted risk-disclosure requirements on sellers of those products.§由于担心近来的某些金融危机因消费者误解信用卡、贷款等金融产品的相关风险而**加剧**，许多国家的政策制定者对这些产品的销售方设立了风险披露要求。§§§§be exacerbated by… 因…而加剧§只用于使负面事物更糟，不能用于好的变化§改译文：exacerbated by 是「因…而加剧」，原译成「源于」

30547§savor§ˈseɪvə§v. 品味；细细享受；体会§On average, those who kept good news secret reported feeling more energized by the experience than participants who shared did, perhaps, as the researchers suggest, because the choice to savor good news is usually a personal one and autonomous motivation is linked with feelings of vitality.§平均而言，把好消息保密的人报告说，这一经历让他们更有活力，胜过把消息分享出去的人；研究者认为，这也许是因为「**细细品味**好消息」通常是个人自主的选择，而自主性动机与活力感相关联。§§§§savor good news 品味好消息§§

30549§reciprocity§ˌresɪˈprɒsəti§n. 互惠；对等回报；相互性§The team also found that the specific type of nudge (reciprocity, compensation, etc.) did not significantly affect user behavior.§团队还发现，助推的具体类型（**互惠**、补偿等）并未显著影响用户行为。§§§reciprocal 相互的 → reciprocity；行为经济学常用§reciprocity nudge 互惠式助推§§

30550§barter§ˈbɑːtə§n. 物物交换；易货贸易 v. 以物易物；讨价还价§By using specific goods like cotton as common units of exchange, commodity currency economies streamline trade, which is why they often replaced barter economies.§通过以棉花等特定商品作为共同交换单位，商品货币经济简化了贸易，这也是它们往往取代**物物交换**经济的原因。§Economists Bruce Champ and Scott Freeman: bartering requires that “the person with whom you wish to trade must not only have what you want but also want what you have.”§经济学家 Bruce Champ 与 Scott Freeman 指出：**以物易物**要求「你想与之交易的人，不仅要拥有你想要的东西，还必须想要你拥有的东西」。§§barter economy 物物交换经济§§改例句2：句末补上缺的右引号
